resources.name: fcc_hs_free_energy.csv

access.notes: Precomputed table of hard-sphere fcc solid free energy per particle f0(γ) as a function of effective packing fraction γ. Provided as a CSV file with columns gamma and f0.

resources.notes: This file provides the reference hard-sphere free energy needed by the variational model. It is based on the constrained MWDA for fcc hard spheres and is given as part of the task resources.
